title: Reading Drill — Benches Along a Steep Route
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Benches Along a Steep Route
passages.body:
**A** The path to a hillside clinic looked short on a map, but the slope made it tiring. Researchers walked the route with older residents, who pointed out that the difficult stretch began before the steepest part.

**B** The design team initially spaced benches equally. It then moved one bench to the edge of a level landing, where users could slow down and sit without obstructing people coming downhill.

**C** In a second trial, the team asked visitors how far they would walk without resting. It also counted how often each bench was used, separating use by waiting patients from use by people taking a rest break.
